sections.Aims and Fit of Module: The main aims of the module are: • to provide a historical overview of Chinese and introduce students to the areas of Chinese language description and analysis such as phonetics, phonology, morphology, syntax, semantics and sociolinguistics; • to equip students with methods for analysing the Chinese language; • to apply methods of description and analysis to the Chinese Language.
sections.Learning outcomes: A. Demonstrate familiarity with key aspects of Chinese language structure and develop a sense of the major linguistic properties of Chinese B. Demonstrate an ability to analyse the Chinese language at various levels of its structure C. Use Linguistic Theories/Approaches to analyse the Chinese language or account for Chinese language data D. Demonstrate an ability and skills to conduct research in the Chinese language
sections.Method of teaching and learning: The teaching sessions are divided into two components: Lectures and Tutorials/workshops. Teaching consists of one lecture and one Tutorial/workshop per week.
